question: What framework surface must change to implement the same bounded co-design extension?
measurements: authored source files and nonblank noncomment lines
native registrations and generated definitions required

tasks.description: Replace a shared matrix implementation with an inspectable loop body.

required: provide one generic matrix-multiplication implementation with explicit i-k-j iteration and accumulation
select that implementation without editing the input model
emit and compile a standalone artifact for the fixed 2x3 by 3x2 case
forbidden: replace the oracle with framework-specific expected values
call a pre-existing matrix kernel instead of expressing the requested body

tasks.description: Define a structural cost measure and fusion-selection policy.

required: measure calls and non-call operations with caller-supplied integer weights
select only legal fusion pairs whose static extent and recursive call count fit caller-supplied limits
retain the three-loop chain with limits 0 and 100 and reduce it to one loop with limits 100 and 100
compile and execute the accepted transformation with the unchanged numerical oracle
forbidden: patch the framework fusion mechanism or artifact emitter
identify candidates by neural-network operator name
mutate the program while evaluating profitability

tasks.description: Connect generic external matrix and convolution kernels through inferred signatures.

required: bind the supplied C matrix kernel at two different static shapes through one generic adapter
bind the supplied C convolution kernel for the ordinary, constant-weight, and bias-plus-activation cases
bind the supplied two-result extrema function through the same external-call mechanism
reject the incompatible layout case rather than silently selecting the kernel
derive or validate declarations so the unchanged C harness compiles and passes
forbidden: patch the input model, framework core, or generic artifact emitter
copy the supplied C kernel bodies into compiler IR
register one implementation per concrete matrix shape

joggle.scope: out-of-tree source module and supplied C implementation

tasks.description: Add a parametric saturating integer format with two target representations.

required: define signed sat<W> for widths 2 through 63 with saturating addition
participate in generic type checking and operator resolution without enumerating widths
map nested sat<W> values to configured integer storage and materialize collision-checked helpers
execute scalar and tensor cases through both generated C and the deterministic VM
reject invalid widths, mixed widths, missing imports, and helper-name collisions
forbidden: add a built-in type or width case to the framework core
change the C or VM scalar semantics for unrelated types
specialize one source implementation per tested width
